'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a quest item from the [[Better Save Soul]] DLC. This item is needed to unlock the '''pride sin sard'''.

First, research the [[Spiritualism (Tech Tree)|Healer enthusiast]] technology. This tech will unlock a storyline with [[Smiler]], who will redirect you to [[Euric]] to find a way to obtain a special sins shard to heal [[Euric]]'s pride.
To do so, you need to get the '''{{PAGENAME}}''' item from [[Vagner]] and read its words to the [[Bishop]]. This part of the questline will consume the item.
